test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The 'Revised Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram' is being implemented (w.e.f 2022-23) by the _____.
solution:
The correct answer is** ****__Ministry of Minority Affairs__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The revised PMJVK will be implemented in all districts of the country including all the Aspirational Districts.
 
• The projects under PMJVK will be proposed in any area where the concentration of the minority population is more than 25% in the catchment area (15 KM radius).
 
• The revised PMJVK has been approved by the Government for continuation over the** 15th Finance Commission Cycle i.e., during FY 2021-22 to 2025-26.**
 
• **PMJVK **will support the State/UTs in creating infrastructure to improve the quality of life of people and reduce the imbalances in the identified minority concentration areas to be at par with the rest of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on May 2, 2018, approved the proposal for renaming and restructuring of the Multi-sectoral Development Programme (MsDP) as Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK).
 
• The restructured program would provide better socio-economic infrastructure facilities to the minority communities, particularly in the field of education, health & skill development. 
 
• The area to be covered under **PMJVK would be 57% more as compared to the existing MsDP.**
 
• The MsDP covered 196 districts of the country whereas PMJVK will cover 308 districts of the country.
